issue_context.title: "Create New Node" dialog main scrolling area is not scrolled up to the top when summoning it
issue_context.body: ### Tested versions - Not reproducible in: - v3.6.beta5.official [2a347ab86] - Reproducible in: - v4.0.4.stable.official [fc0b241c9] - v4.1.4.stable.official [fe0e8e557] - v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3] - v4.3.beta.custom_build [6a13fdcae] ### System information Godot v4.3.beta (6a13fdcae) - macOS 14.5.0 - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max - Apple M3 Max (16 Threads) ### Issue description ### Steps to reproduce 1. Click on the Add Node button. 2. See the offsetted scroll in the Create Node dialog. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) n/a
comments: Create resource suffers from the same problem.

review_comments:
Won't that break things when `base_type` is not `Node`? We still want the base type to be in focus.

The problem here is that Node isn't properly in focus, that's likely a themeing or math issue.
